classAttendance.emptyHoliday: No class is on holiday today.

classChart.subtitle: Percentage of students present in each class; a half day counts as half.

sessions.title: Academic sessions
sessions.subtitle: School years and their term dates. Results, attendance totals and report cards count over these dates.
sessions.dialogHint: Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends, and both terms must fall inside the session.
sessions.nameHint: Write the session as two years, like 2027-28.
sessions.defaultsError: Couldn't fill in the default dates, so pick them below.

marksEntry.loadFailed: Couldn't load the saved marks for this test, so editing is paused to protect them.
marksEntry.changedElsewhere: The saved marks for this test changed elsewhere. Reload to see them.
marksEntry.importHint: One row per student per exam. Required: class_name, subject, exam_type (an exam component from Class Subjects, e.g. P.T. First), session (e.g. 2026-27), student_id, and marks (or grade, A1–D, for graded exams such as Term 1 Grade). Max marks come from Class Subjects. Rows are saved as draft batches, exactly like this form; submitted (locked) batches are rejected.
marksEntry.optionalListed_one: Optional subject: only the {{count}} student taking it is listed.
marksEntry.optionalListed_other: Optional subject: only the {{count}} students taking it are listed.
marksEntry.optionalNone: No student takes this subject yet. The super-admin ticks the students on Class Subjects.

classSubjects.bothWarning_one: {{count}} component is set to “Both”, so it counts in Term 1 and again in Term 2. Pick a single term unless that is intended.
classSubjects.bothWarning_other: {{count}} components are set to “Both”, so they count in Term 1 and again in Term 2. Pick a single term unless that is intended.
classSubjects.forceDeleteBody: Their marks stay in the database but no longer count in results or report cards. To rename a component instead, edit its name in place rather than deleting and re-adding it.
classSubjects.optionalHint: Only the students ticked below get marks and results for this subject. It never affects promotion.
classSubjects.wholeClass: The whole class takes {{subject}}. Tick “Optional subject” if only some students take it, such as Mathematics as an additional subject in 11th and 12th.
classSubjects.optionalOn: {{subject}} is now an optional subject. Tick the students who take it, then save.
classSubjects.optionalOff: {{subject}} is taken by the whole class again.
classSubjects.takersUnsaved: Changes to who takes this subject aren't saved yet.

results.draftHint: Marks not submitted yet (still a draft)
results.pickClass: Pick a class to see its results.
results.term2Empty: No Term 2 marks yet, so this shows Term 1. Pick Term 2 under Scope to see it.
results.forbidden: You don't have access to the results of {{cls}}. Ask an admin to add this class and the Results menu to your account.
results.serverUpdating: The server is being updated. Try again in a minute.
results.noSubjects: No subjects are set up for {{cls}} in {{scope}} yet. A super-admin can add them under Class Subjects.
results.provisionalNote: Ranks are provisional until every subject is entered and submitted
results.csvProvisional: Provisional results: not every subject is entered and submitted yet, so totals and ranks can still change.
results.caption: Results for {{cls}}, {{scope}}, session {{session}}
results.noMarks: No marks entered for {{cls}} · {{scope}} in {{session}} yet.
results.optionalHint: Optional subject: it counts only for the students who take it, and never affects promotion.

reportCards.title: Report cards
reportCards.pickClass: Pick a class to see its report cards.
reportCards.pickSession: Pick a session to see its report cards.
reportCards.resolveError: Couldn't check for a report-card template.
reportCards.askAdmin: Ask an admin to create it.
reportCards.createAllConfirm: Create {{scope}} report-card templates for every class in {{session}}? Classes that already have one are skipped.
reportCards.setUpHint: There is no report-card template for this class, session and term yet. Pick how marks are laid out; signatures and other card settings can be changed later.
reportCards.createAllHint: “Create for all classes” makes one {{scope}} template per class for {{session}} with this layout, and skips classes that already have one.
reportCards.reportCardsOnly: This view is for report-card templates.
reportCards.fixRowsFirst: Fix the rows marked in red first.
reportCards.alreadyRunning: Cards for this class are already being generated. Showing that run.
reportCards.generateFailed: The report card couldn't be generated.
reportCards.englishRemarkMissing: Add the English remark too; the Punjabi line prints under it.
reportCards.daysPresentTooHigh: Days present ({{present}}) can't be more than working days ({{working}}).
reportCards.attendanceNeedsAdmin: An admin needs to correct this student's attendance override before the card can print.
reportCards.loadError: Couldn't load the report cards for this class.
reportCards.includeDraftsHintOn: This template's card settings print draft marks. Untick to leave them off; those cards then show as “Needs update”.
reportCards.includeDraftsHintOff: This template's card settings leave draft marks off. Tick to print them; those cards then show as “Needs update”.
reportCards.dataLoadError: Couldn't load the saved remarks and houses, so editing is paused.
reportCards.legendFresh: matches the current marks and remarks
reportCards.legendStale: something changed after the card was made; generate it again
reportCards.legendProvisional: some marks are missing or still drafts, so totals and rank can still change
reportCards.draftsHint_one: {{count}} mark is still a draft and stays off the card
reportCards.draftsHint_other: {{count}} marks are still drafts and stay off the card
reportCards.previewSaveFirst: Save this row's changes first: the preview shows what is saved.
reportCards.previewTemplateDrafts: The preview follows the card settings for draft marks, not the “Include draft marks” choice here.
reportCards.zipOutdated_one: {{count}} card from this run changed afterwards (it shows “Needs update”), so the ZIP leaves it out. Generate it again to include it.
reportCards.zipOutdated_other: {{count}} cards from this run changed afterwards (they show “Needs update”), so the ZIP leaves them out. Generate them again to include them.
reportCards.zipOutdatedConfirm_one: {{count}} card from this run is out of date and is left out of the ZIP. Download the other cards anyway?
reportCards.zipOutdatedConfirm_other: {{count}} cards from this run are out of date and are left out of the ZIP. Download the other cards anyway?
reportCards.previewDownloaded: Pop-ups are blocked, so the preview was downloaded instead.

templates.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Its generated PDFs are deleted too. Remarks and other per-student entries stay saved.
templates.emptyAdmin: No templates yet. Use “New template” to set up report cards for every class in one go.
templates.emptyStaff: No templates for your classes yet.
templates.layoutComponentsHint: A column for each exam (P.T. First, P.T. Second, Semester …), then total and grade.
templates.layoutComponentsHintAnnual: Term 1 and Term 2 columns for each subject, then total and grade.
templates.layoutSummaryHint: Marks, maximum and grade for each subject.
templates.intro: Report cards have one template per class, session and term: it holds the card settings (layout, signatures, what to print), while marks, rank and attendance come from the results. PSEB admit cards have one template per class with the exam centre and date sheet.
templates.newHintReportCard: One report-card template per class for the chosen session and term. Signatures and what the card shows are set on the template's page afterwards.
templates.newHintPseb: One admit-card template per class and session. The exam centre and date sheet are filled in on the next screen.
templates.scopeHint: Which marks the card adds up: one term's exams, or the whole year.
templates.termLabelHint: Printed in the card's title. Leave blank for “{{label}}”.
templates.someExist_one: {{count}} of these classes already has a {{scope}} template for {{session}} and will be skipped: {{classes}}.
templates.someExist_other: {{count}} of these classes already have a {{scope}} template for {{session}} and will be skipped: {{classes}}.
templates.notFound: This template doesn't exist. It may have been deleted.
templates.noAccess: You don't have access to this template.
templates.setScopeConfirm: Set this template's scope to {{scope}}? It can't be changed afterwards.
templates.setScopeMismatchConfirm: This template's cards print {{current}} results now. Set its scope to {{scope}} instead? It can't be changed afterwards.
templates.scopeMissingTitle: This template doesn't say which results it prints yet.
templates.scopeDerivedTitle: Confirm which results this template prints
templates.scopeDerivedAdmin: It was made before templates had a scope, so its cards print {{scope}} results, worked out from its term label. Confirm the scope to store it with the template. It can be set only once.
templates.scopeMissingAdmin: It was made before templates had a scope. Pick Term 1, Term 2 or Annual so its cards can be generated. The scope can be set only once.
templates.scopeMissingStaff: An admin has to pick Term 1, Term 2 or Annual before its cards can be generated.
templates.settingsSaved: Card settings saved. Cards are re-rendered the next time they are generated.
templates.passPctInvalid: Enter a pass mark from 0 to 100.
templates.maxFailsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 20.
templates.settingsHint: Used on every {{scope}} report card of {{cls}} for {{session}}.
templates.includeDraftsHint: Prints marks whose batch is still a draft. Only a super-admin can change this.
templates.includeDraftsOn: A super-admin set these cards to include draft marks.
templates.signaturesHint: Names printed under the signature lines. Leave a name blank for an empty line.
templates.defaultRuleIs: School default: pass mark {{pct}}% in every academic subject; up to {{fails}} failed subjects means Conditional.
templates.promotionRuleHint: Annual cards then print Promoted (no failed subject), Conditional (up to that many failed subjects) or Detained (more).
templates.remarksDefaultHint: Printed only on the cards of students who have no remark of their own.
templates.reRenderNote: After saving, every card of this template is re-rendered the next time it is generated.
templates.previewUnavailable: The student list couldn't be loaded; see the report cards below.
templates.previewNoMarks: No student has marks for {{scope}} yet, so there is nothing to preview.
templates.previewHint: Shows one student's card with the saved settings in a new tab. Nothing is stored.
templates.previewUnsaved: You have unsaved settings. The preview shows the saved ones, so save first to see your changes.
templates.adminOnly: Only an admin can change these.

pseb.saved: Admit card details saved. Cards are re-rendered the next time they are generated.
pseb.saveNote: After saving, every admit card of this class is re-rendered the next time it is generated.
pseb.missingIds: Fill in the roll no. and registration no.
pseb.requiredHint: Each student needs a PSEB roll no. and registration no. before their details can be saved.
pseb.dataLoadError: Couldn't load the saved details, so editing is paused.
pseb.chunkHint: Cards are generated {{n}} at a time; keep this page open until it finishes.
pseb.missingDobHint: No date of birth on the student's record: the admit card can't be generated until it is added.
